_note: A pinned vector for the weights digest of serving-atr-inference#200. Byte-identical in training-atr-models, whose promotion gate measures the same thing and cannot import atr_serving. The digest is sha256 over the lines '<relative name> <sha256> <size>', sorted by name, over the files listed in 'hashed' only — config.json and metadata.json are not weights. If this value changes, every recorded digest in both repos means something else: change it only with that in mind.

files.model-00001-of-00002.safetensors: the first shard, byte for byte
files.model-00002-of-00002.safetensors: the second shard, byte for byte
